node: Student-finance, loan-servicing, repayment, and compliance rails
summary: Expanded the student-finance and loan-servicing rails node into a focused four-name universe. The strongest direct exposures are Nelnet and Maximus/Aidvantage for federal student-loan servicing operations, with Sallie Mae as the private education-loan reference lender/servicer. Flywire is the underfollowed adjacent payments/compliance rail: not a student-loan servicer, but a tuition and education-payment infrastructure provider that may benefit from affordability, payment-plan, cross-border payment, and institutional payment-compliance complexity. No buy/sell view is implied.
